description: Repairs r-lock-3-4-txn/write-alloc-counter-rollback: the AutoNumber ID read after Update returned row 1 for every writer, because the cursor stays on the old record, so the generated value after Update was not captured. Process a begins a transaction and appends a row to table C (AutoNumber ID) through a dynaset AddNew/Update, reading ID after AddNew, after Update, after MoveLast and through SELECT @@IDENTITY; process b (no transaction) appends a row the same way; a rolls back; b appends another; a appends another after its rollback. The rows of C are read at the end by b and a.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
